overview.en_us: Watches every connection leaving this machine, maps where it is headed, names the application responsible, and flags behaviour worth a second look. Observes only: nothing is blocked or modified. All data stays on the device.

custom.en_us: Host networking is required. A container on a bridge sees Docker's own network rather than yours, and the dashboard would come up empty. Patrol Mode also needs a vantage point to see other devices: run this on the router or on a mirror port, otherwise a switch shows only this machine's traffic.
